_meta.description: Average and total spend profile per treatment arm on experiment.pulse in one slot each: a named vector lists revenue_before, revenue and session_minutes with display labels, AGG_VEC_MEAN returns one mean per member as a JSON array (in member order) and AGG_VEC_SUM one total per member. Missing data is per element: a null member skips only that element, so components.aggregations[i].operator.element_n can differ by member while the floor n counts rows where any member answered. An element no row answered is null in the mean and 0 in the sum. Array-valued: never a crosstab cell, a Sort key or an overlay host.
_meta.name: vector_profile_per_arm
